Query the Ensembl REST API

Source: R/analysis_information.R
queryEnsembl.Rd

Query the Ensembl REST API

Usage

queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Character: API path

query

Character: API query

grch37

Boolean: query the Ensembl GRCh37 API? if FALSE, query the most recent API

Value

Parsed response or NULL if no response

Examples

path  <- "overlap/region/human/7:140424943-140624564"
query <- list(feature = "gene")
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
#>          biotype       end version         gene_id feature_type     start
#> 1 protein_coding 140624564       8 ENSG00000157764         gene 140419127
#> 2          snRNA 140583978       1 ENSG00000271932         gene 140583872
#>                                                                   description
#> 1 v-raf murine sarcoma viral oncogene homolog B [Source:HGNC Symbol;Acc:1097]
#> 2                               U6 spliceosomal RNA [Source:RFAM;Acc:RF00026]
#>   external_name assembly_name                          logic_name
#> 1          BRAF        GRCh37 ensembl_havana_gene_homo_sapiens_37
#> 2            U6        GRCh37               ncrna_homo_sapiens_37
#>   canonical_transcript seq_region_name         source strand              id
#> 1    ENST00000288602.6               7 ensembl_havana     -1 ENSG00000157764
#> 2    ENST00000605989.1               7        ensembl      1 ENSG00000271932

path  <- "lookup/symbol/human/BRCA2"
query <- list(expand=1)
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
